title: The v2 bench: the veto-form race that T0 never ran, and a sunset that has already expired

THE_DOUBLE_DIP_HANDLED_IN_THE_OPEN.the_problem: T0 already raced product against additive on this exact cohort. Re-reporting that comparison as a v2 finding would be counting one look twice.
THE_DOUBLE_DIP_HANDLED_IN_THE_OPEN.the_rule: product-vs-additive at baseline is logged CONFIRMATORY ONLY and contributes to NO gate and NO score in v2. The genuinely new in-container test is V2a: the minimum (veto) form, which T0 never computed.
THE_DOUBLE_DIP_HANDLED_IN_THE_OPEN.why_V2a_is_clean: It is a single index requiring NO fitting, so there is no overfitting and no fold reuse. Direction-free AUC is used (max of a, 1-a) because an index may point either way and pre-committing to a sign would be a hidden researcher degree of freedom.

PATHS_IN_THE_SUPPLIED_MODULE_THAT_DO_NOT.note: The supplied trcf_v2_tests.py references files and fields that are not in this repository. Recorded rather than silently repaired, because a spec that names absent data is exactly what the status vocabulary is for.
PATHS_IN_THE_SUPPLIED_MODULE_THAT_DO_NOT.lism-cohorts/repos992.json: ABSENT. The real cohort is data/github/govphys_quadratic_results.csv, 992 rows.
PATHS_IN_THE_SUPPLIED_MODULE_THAT_DO_NOT.lism-cohorts/repo_deps.json: ABSENT. A real dependency graph does exist at data/pypi/dep_graph_edges.csv (1287 edges, 540 nodes) but it is PyPI packages, not these GitHub repositories: only 27 names overlap, and name-matching across ecosystems is unreliable. It cannot serve as this cohort's edge file.
PATHS_IN_THE_SUPPLIED_MODULE_THAT_DO_NOT.registered_at / archived_at: ABSENT. No temporal field exists, so V1's forward holdout cannot be constructed.
PATHS_IN_THE_SUPPLIED_MODULE_THAT_DO_NOT.dep_shock / maintainer_loss / issue_spik: ABSENT. No pre-outcome shock marker exists, so V2b's stress subset cannot be defined.

THE_SUNSET_HAS_ALREADY_EXPIRED.rule_as_written: SUNSET = 2026-06-30. If V2b stays CONDITIONAL past that date, the tail lemma is demoted to a weight-zero prior and the branch stands on cascade alone.
THE_SUNSET_HAS_ALREADY_EXPIRED.consequence: The date has passed and V2b is CONDITIONAL, because no pre-outcome shock marker exists in this cohort. THE DEMOTION FIRES NOW. This is the seatbelt working exactly as designed -- by date, not by mood -- and it fires against the carrier, not for it.

W1_INDEPENDENCE_GATE_REPEATED_PRE_OUTCOM.claim: VIF < 5 on logU, D_enc, D_dec, features only, before any v2 outcome look.

W2_PRIMARY_V2a_THE_VETO_FORM_RACE.claim: The minimum form min(U, D_enc, D_dec) was never computed in T0. Race it against additive at baseline.
W2_PRIMARY_V2a_THE_VETO_FORM_RACE.passes_if: the race runs on a single index with no fitting, and the verdict is reported whichever way it falls. V2a FIRES if additive - minimum < 0.01.

W3_THE_DOUBLE_DIP_IS_LOGGED_NOT_COUNTED.claim: product-vs-additive appears in the output labelled CONFIRMATORY ONLY and contributes to no gate.
W3_THE_DOUBLE_DIP_IS_LOGGED_NOT_COUNTED.passes_if: the label is present and no counted gate depends on that comparison.

W4_THE_SUNSET_FIRES_BY_DATE.claim: V2b is CONDITIONAL and the sunset date has passed, so the tail lemma demotes to weight-zero.
W4_THE_SUNSET_FIRES_BY_DATE.passes_if: the run compares today against SUNSET, finds it expired, and records the demotion as EXECUTED rather than as a recommendation.

W5_EVERY_UNRUN_TEST_CARRIES_A_STATUS_AND.claim: V1, V2b, V3a, V3b, V3c, V4, V5 each carry a status from the declared vocabulary plus the artefact that would unblock them.
W5_EVERY_UNRUN_TEST_CARRIES_A_STATUS_AND.passes_if: all seven carry both, and none is described as pending or in progress.

W6_V6_DRY_RUN_PROVES_THE_KNIFE_AND_THE_S.claim: The inward knife reclassifies a synthetic canary as RIBA-STRUCTURE, and an F3 fire removes L2 from the surviving stack.
W6_V6_DRY_RUN_PROVES_THE_KNIFE_AND_THE_S.passes_if: both assertions hold. This proves the invocation logic BEFORE it is ever needed, which is the only time proving it is cheap.

W7_does_V2a_firing_rescue_A2.claim: Partly, and the distinction matters. A2 as WRITTEN says viability is the PRODUCT; T0 refuted that and v2 does not disturb it. A2's stated intuition -- 'a zero in any factor zeroes the claim' -- is VETO semantics, which is what min() encodes. So the axiom's idea may survive while its formalisation does not. That is a real distinction and it is not a rescue of the published form.
W7_does_V2a_firing_rescue_A2.reason: reinterpreting a refuted formalisation post hoc is exactly what the anti-immunisation rule forbids counting

W8_does_any_of_this_touch_the_reading_of.claim: No. Every form raced here is an operationalisation chosen downstream of the schema. The aya is not a functional form.

preflight_probe_recorded_before_locking.note: The veto form WINS. V2a fires. The product sits at chance, reproducing T0.

scoring: 6 counted gates. W7 and W8 are excluded.
